item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a strong 2024 counterexample such as refusal of inspection or verification, rejection of nonproliferation commitments, bad-faith disarmament language, or a documented attempt to sabotage an arms-control agreement. The one thing missing is a major new treaty result in 2024, but absence of a deal is not itself evidence of bad faith.","evidence":[{"title":"Statement by the United States on the Twentieth Anniversary of UNSCR 1540","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"April 29, 2024","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/statement-by-the-united-states-on-the-twentieth-anniversary-of-unscr-1540/","summary":"The United States called UNSCR 1540 one of the most important tools against proliferation and urged states to keep sensitive WMD-related goods and know-how under regulatory control.
